# Job data

}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Sets and parameters
n = len(jobs)
job_ids = list(jobs.keys())

# Variables
C = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(job_ids, job_ids, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # Sequencing variables

# Objective: Minimize weighted sum of tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in job_ids), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Completion time constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in job_ids if i != j))

# Tardiness constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j:
            model.addConstr(x[i, j] + x[j, i] == 1)

# Solve the model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = sorted(job_ids, key=lambda j: C[j].X)

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
